brands.name: Overlaid
brands.description: OBS overlays, a Twitch bot and an operator desk for live streams.
brands.mark_description: A tally lamp: a rounded overlay card offset over a second card, with a lit red circle in the top corner of the front card.

brands.name: Pirs
brands.description: An experimental, extensible AT Protocol personal data server: a fork of the Bluesky PDS with plugin hook points.
brands.mark_description: A pier seen from the side: one long plank over three pilings, with one orange hook-point dot on the plank and thin blue construction lines.

brands.name: tmux-popups
brands.description: A tmux popup toolkit: a quick menu and bindings generated from a TSV registry.
brands.mark_description: A popup over a pane: a thin-outlined rectangle with a smaller solid rectangle inset at its centre, carrying a thicker top bar and one green block cursor.

brands.name: Arkhiv
brands.description: A zine archive: original files preserved, a catalogue with a reader and downloads.
brands.mark_description: Three stacked, slightly offset sheets with two staple marks on the top sheet; the top sheet's outline is misregistered in riso red and blue.

brands.name: Omarchy Multi-Monitor Bar
brands.description: A separate Omarchy bar layout for each monitor.
brands.mark_description: Two monitor rectangles side by side, each with a bar strip along its top edge: full width on the left, minimal on the right.

brands.name: Super Productivity for Omarchy
brands.description: The current Super Productivity task and its timer in the Omarchy top bar.
brands.mark_description: A timer ring: a thin circle with a thick three-quarter progress arc, and a short horizontal bar beneath it.

brands.name: Spool
brands.description: An animated cassette desktop companion for Omarchy that follows agent activity.
brands.mark_description: A cassette outline: a rounded rectangle with two reel circles joined by a tape window, and one green eye-dot in the left reel.

brands.name: Shelfish
brands.description: Collapsible, named groups of Omarchy bar widgets.
brands.mark_description: A shelf: a horizontal rule with two small boxes sitting on it and a chevron in the third place, for a collapsed group.

brands.name: Metronome + Tuner
brands.description: A metronome and chromatic tuner inside Obsidian.
brands.mark_description: A metronome: a tall trapezoid outline with a diagonal pendulum and a bob circle, and a short tick scale on its right side for the tuner.

brands.name: super-productivity-mcp
brands.description: An MCP server, plugin bridge and quick-add launcher for Super Productivity.
brands.mark_description: A bridge: two short vertical posts joined by an arc, with a dot at the arc's apex.
